name: Atelier — Sketch to Sewing Pattern
description: A multi-agent AI system that converts fashion sketches or garment photos into complete, printable sewing patterns with step-by-step instructions. Built with a LangGraph pipeline coordinating four specialized Claude agents (vision, measurement, pattern, instructions), containerized with Docker and served via FastAPI.

name: Real Time Movie Recommendation System
description: The project simulates an early-stage streaming service that serves personalized movie recommendations to users. The system is designed to handle a dataset of approximately 1 million users and 27,000 movies, considering real-world challenges like scalability, reliability, and model drift.

name: Restaurant Finder RAG Chatbot
description: A RAG chatbot providing precise restaurant recommendations based on user location and dietary preferences. Utilizes FAISS for efficient data retrieval and OpenAI’s GPT-3.5 Turbo for enhanced conversational abilities.

name: Language Detector/Translator App
description: Developed an Android app for language detection and translation. Deployed a RESTful web service on GitHub Codespaces using Docker and integrated MongoDB for operational analytics.

name: Appointment Scheduling API
description: A Python Flask backend application for scheduling, managing, and tracking appointments. Supports multiple databases, and handles time zones for users from different cities.
